data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports a calendar year release relating to prior accident years: a net surplus of GBP 14.029m arising from reassessment of claims for previous accident years. A gross prior-year movement on a GROSS basis is not explicitly disclosed in a standalone movement note, so the reported net prior-year surplus has been used as a fallback. Current-year pressures included COVID-19 (net impact GBP 33.4m) and adverse performance in the Engineering book, but these relate principally to 2020 activity rather than the prior-year reserve reassessment.
raw_causal_phrases: Within the calendar year technical result, a surplus of GBP 14,029,000 (2019: 15,189,000 deficit) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.

The net claims ratio of 65.9% (2019:70.7%) reflects the impact of COVID-19, which contributed GBP 33.4 million or 11.2% to the overall net loss ratio, and worse than expected performance on the Engineering book which experienced a series of losses during the year.

data.data_quality_notes: A gross prior-year movement (movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding) expressed on a GROSS (insurance liabilities) basis was not provided as a single explicit gross figure in the movement note. The report explicitly states a net prior-year surplus of GBP 14.029m; this net figure has been used as a fallback per instructions and is flagged here. A gross claims development table (triangle) is present but the table formatting in the source is complex to parse unambiguously; therefore the gross PYD was not computed from the triangle. Also note there was a Part VII transfer on 30 Dec 2020 with no net economic impact - that transaction could distort certain presentations around year-end but was economically neutral.
